title: Tourists at Yosemite Valley Tunnel View, 1950s B&W Landscape Snapshot Photo
description: A classic black-and-white landscape snapshot taken from the famous Tunnel View scenic overlook in Yosemite National Park, California. In the midground, Bridalveil Fall cascades down rugged granite cliffs surrounded by dense pine forests. In the foreground to the right, several tourists in mid-century attire stand along the stone parapet enjoying the vista, while a tall conifer frames the left side of the scene. The photo features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-century personal photography during the boom of American automobile road trips to National Parks.
